raw_text:
`src/indieweb/`: Django IndieAuth/Micropub/Webmention; `tests/`: Pytest (`tests.settings`, `DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE`); `docs/`: Sphinx (`just docs`); examples/helpers: `examples/`, `example_project.py`, `client.py`.

Install: `uv sync` (or `just install`). Test: `uv run pytest` (or `just test`); target: `uv run pytest tests/test_file.py::TestClass::test_case -v`. Types: `uv run mypy` (or `just typecheck`). Lint/format: `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format .` (119 chars, double quotes). Matrix/hooks: `tox` or `tox -e pre-commit`. Fast tests: `pytest -k "keyword"` or `just test-one path::node`.

Python 3.10+, 4-space indentation; type-annotate public functions/classes. Ruff `E,W,F,I,B,UP,DJ`; avoid unused/dead code. Naming: `snake_case`, `PascalCase`, `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`. Keep app boundaries: views/handlers in `indieweb`, templates in `templates/indieweb/`, assets in `static/indieweb/`. New behavior requires `tests/test_*.py`, mirroring modules. Tests use `--cov-config=pyproject.toml` and reuse DB; reset/mark transactional tests for schema changes. Prefer focused regression tests and fixtures. Migrations: `indieweb/migrations/`.

Beads: database `.beads/`; `BEADS_NO_DAEMON=1`, `BEADS_DIR="$PWD/.beads"`. Start: `bd update <bead-id> --status in_progress`; context/deps: `bd --no-daemon --no-db show <bead-id>` and `bd --no-daemon --no-db dep tree <bead-id>`. Read referenced specs/PRDs. Comments’ first non-empty line must be `Ready for review:`, `LGTM`, or `Changes requested:`; include summary/validation. Avoid `bd sync` unless asked; worktrees use `bd --no-daemon sync --flush-only`. Beadsflow implementer `codex`, reviewer `claude`; configure `beadsflow.toml` or env vars. Use local `../beadsflow`, e.g. `uv run --project ../beadsflow beadsflow run <epic-id> ...`. Scoped, imperative commits.

Before PR: `uv run pytest`, `uv run mypy`, `uv run ruff check .`; describe change, impact, tests, issues; screenshots/API samples for user-facing changes. Update docs/examples and state migration implications. Never commit secrets/tokens; use environment variables. Validate inputs early; typed interfaces for HTTP calls. Keep external calls behind clear interfaces.
